name: launch-craft
description: Turn repository briefs, plans, code and mocks into traceable OVERVIEW.md and PRD.md documents, then an interactive launch site grounded in the actual product. Runs four phases: product synthesis, positioning and copy, implementation through design-craft:design-craft and ux-craft:ux-craft, and rendered acceptance. Uses the project's confirmed audience, pricing and supported platforms. Use for "build a launch site for this repo", "update the PRD and marketing website", or "turn these product briefs into a launch page".
